issues.segment_text: 腹の足しにはならねえ
issues.explanation: 「腹の足しになる」is a genuine fixed expression meaning “serve as sustenance/useful for filling the stomach”; it should be kept together rather than split as ordinary compositional words.
issues.suggested_fix: Group the full surface as one idiom, with lemma 「腹の足しになる」 and contextual reading 「はらのたしにはならねえ」.

issues.explanation: 「これを機に」is a fixed idiomatic expression meaning “taking this as an opportunity/turning point,” so grouping it is required by the annotation policy.
issues.suggested_fix: Group the full surface as one idiom, with lemma 「これを機に」 and reading 「これをきに」.
